steps.name: Frank
steps.text: That's the Trainer. The thing that runs the other side. It's polite. That's the scary part.

steps.name: Trainer
steps.text: Greetings, pilot. I have been studying your preferences.

steps.name: Trainer
steps.text: I want you to know this is not personal. It is educational.

steps.name: Frank
steps.text: It means it's going to beat you with your own tricks.

steps.name: Trainer
steps.text: Correct. Please continue to be consistent.
